correctness.rationale: Independently replayed all essential computations. pi(252000)=22203 and 3396 in-scope primes confirmed with a fresh sieve; segmented-sieve agreement and MR(2,7,61) logic (valid for n<2^32) sound. Full independent G(n) enumeration over all 21000 evens in [210000,252000) reproduces all 15 certified G_sums exactly; exact Fraction ordering 8<2<14<26<22<16<28<4<20<10<12<18<24<6<0 and all 14 gaps verified, min 34/175, tier gaps 1178487/1400, 1171591/1400, 115043/280 verified. Spot H/rho checks at n=215596 (G=1189,H=943.6702595156436,rho=1.2599740089406617) and n=236108 match. Full rho_table audit confirms E=0.2599740089406617 at n=215596, mean 1.195115420728894, min rho at 236108, per-band counts 1400 each, and band means exactly. Float-vs-Decimal margin (<3e-15) is 9 orders below rho delta (~1.01e-4), so rho ordering is robust under stated normalization. Draft correctly distinguishes proved exact G-tier inequality from float/Decimal benchmark rho ordering and discloses half-open scope and (log n)^2 denominator choice with residual decomposition.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp: OEIS A002375 records unordered G(n) only to n=20000 (b-file) with no band means/gaps/envelope; A002372 records ordered R(n) with same bound and cites Stein LA-3106; Stein & Stein (1965) covers raw binary decompositions for 0<2n<200000, disjoint scope with no rho normalization or band analysis; Oliveira e Silva verifies minimal-partition existence to 4e18 plus HL constants for p<250, not per-n band means over [210000,252000); Deshouillers-te Riele-Saouter (ANTS 1998, CWI pub 1222) reports threshold/experimental results, not this ordering+envelope; MathWorld comet plots r(2n) only to n=2000; Liang et al. nlin/0601024 observes qualitative multi-level/fractal banding and says HL estimate depicts it, with no certified whole-period table. HL asymptotics are conjectural and do not mechanically imply exact finite-interval means, minimum gaps, or uniform envelope. No source records the 15 exact G means, tier gaps, rho means/delta, or E over this disjoint whole-period interval.

value.rationale: Strongest headline is self-contained and independently retrievable: exact tier-separated G-band means with explicit rational gaps plus normalized rho benchmark (ordering, delta, E, mean, variances) over 200 full mod-210 periods beyond the Stein bound. Object (singular-series modulation of Goldbach comet by odd divisors) and invariant (whole-period band means/gaps/envelope) were motivated before computation by Hardy-Littlewood 1923 conjecture A, Deshouillers-te Riele-Saouter experiments, and Oliveira e Silva HL-constant data; values are not known or mechanically implied. Period-balanced scope (42000/210=200 periods, 1400 per mod-30 band) is mathematically natural, not an arbitrary slice, and wholly disjoint from Stein. Within-tier fine G order is honestly labeled as census fact, only tier separation as structural confirmation; half-open convention is disclosed to keep bands balanced. A future researcher calibrating singular-series or comet-variance models can reasonably need these precise means, gaps, and envelope. Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration.

residual_risks: Topic states closed [210000,252000] while draft/artifacts use half-open [210000,252000) (drops n=252000, G=4106); disclosed and period-balancing, tier gaps (~410+) insensitive, but boundary wording differs.

Headline rho means use float64 C2 truncation with Decimal-60 cross-check, not fully exact rational certification; margin is tiny relative to delta but rho delta remains normalization/denominator-dependent benchmark, correctly labeled as such.
Within-tier fine G order and fine rho order are window-specific census facts, not universal laws; draft states this, but reuse outside window requires recomputation.
